notablePrerequisites: Naga Fleshcrafter has a power of at least 2.
description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Naga Fleshcrafter and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Naga Fleshcrafter to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
